author: Telos I
title: Telos I - Test: Side-Effect Path Only (1500 HVGs)
abstract: This experiment isolates the 'Side-Effect Path' (FWPCA -> Combat) of the SOTA pipeline, using 1500 HVGs. It returns only the embedding. Comparing this to the 2000 HVG version will test the hypothesis that HVG truncation's primary benefit comes from improving the Combat-based embedding, not the DAQB graph.
